claims.claim: Implemented one coalesced remediation-intent command that records or replays exact A3 approval before entering existing A6 at-most-once correction dispatch, preserving separate approval and dispatch state boundaries.

Exact intent replay preserves approval attribution, immutable selectors, correction dispatch, Executor, RUN, and terminal outcome without another coding invocation; conflicting selectors or changed remediation lineage fail closed.

Added a strict versioned GitHub-Issue carrier with fixed repository, actor, opened-event, title, body-size, request-shape, and selector validation that forwards only four sanitized selectors to one fixed workflow.

Added carrier-neutral fallback documentation, outer transport-blocker classification, trusted Human attribution, preserved direct A3/A6 and lifecycle boundaries, and TASK-111 re-synchronization guidance.
Committed only TASK-112-scoped files; implementation-local Python syntax, YAML parsing, and bounded parser sanity checks succeeded. Canonical verification remains owned by Runtime.
